title: Photo 218 · 텐트폴 USSBBW · 자주요 흑유 척화 · 선 자세 정면 · 한국 30대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her late 30s, warm ivory skin tone with a soft golden undertone, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, waist-length straight hair swept behind her shoulders, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears long teardrop earrings and has sharp stiletto nails.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so wide that her hips are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. A giant hourglass frame that flares out at both ends: enormous flaring lats spreading to shoulders twice the width of a normal woman's, massive rounded deltoids stacked on top of them, huge thick arms pushed far out from her sides by the width of her back, a smooth rounded neck, a colossal bust projecting forward past the line of her shoulders, no waist at all. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, so much of it that it hangs far lower than it projects — sagging down over the tops of her thighs under its own weight rather than pushing forward, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other as it falls, each fold thicker than the one above it, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Below it colossal wide hips just as broad as her shoulders, a huge rounded rear, colossal thighs pressing together down to the knees and thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame and her shoulders span more than five head-widths. Wide above and wide below; the muscle is huge but rounded and soft-edged under a thick layer of fat, no bodybuilder look. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how every part hangs, settles and presses against the part below it.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic style — a glossy jet-black glaze carved away to reveal bold cream-white peony scrolls and leafy vines, carved cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense leaf scrolls filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Standing square to the camera, full frontal, feet planted far apart, the heavy mass of her middle resting down on her thighs, arms held clear of her body with a visible gap of background between each arm and her side so her whole outline reads unbroken, full body head to toe.

Footwear: Extreme cream-white platform stiletto sandals with a single ankle strap, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the black glaze gleaming, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
